name: Indo Hokke Hotel Restaurant
why_it_matters: The on-property restaurant of Indo Hokke — a Japanese-funded 44-room hotel built to host Buddhist pilgrims from Japan, blending Japanese and Indian architecture. The kitchen is the only place in Rajgir serving genuine Japanese set menus (miso, omelette sets) alongside Indian and Thai food.
insider_tip: Outside guests can dine — the restaurant accepts walk-ins from the main entrance. Confirm Japanese menu availability the same day; supply chain for Japanese ingredients runs from Patna and a few items rotate in and out.
signature_address: Indo Hokke Hotel, near Veer Ayyappa Marg, Rajgir 803116

name: Nature's Nest Restaurant & Banquets
why_it_matters: Currently Rajgir's top-ranked restaurant on TripAdvisor. Multi-cuisine kitchen built around the pilgrim-and-tourist flow with attached banquet space — locally cited for consistency rather than specialisation.
insider_tip: Weekend dinner requires a booking. The dining room sits separate from the banquet side; ask for the restaurant entrance or you'll end up routed through a wedding setup.

name: Aradhya Family Restaurant
area: Hotel Anand Lok, near Bus Stand
why_it_matters: The in-house multi-cuisine restaurant of Hotel Anand Lok near the Rajgir bus stand — useful entry point for travellers arriving by road who want a sit-down meal before the ropeway/Vishwa Shanti Stupa run.
insider_tip: Walk-ins welcome from non-guests. Lunch buffet some days — call ahead. Cash and UPI both work; card terminals can be intermittent.
signature_address: Hotel Anand Lok, near Bus Stand, Rajgir 803116

name: Tathagat Vihar Restaurant
why_it_matters: The in-house restaurant of the Bihar government-aligned Tathagat Vihar Hotel in Dangi Tola — pilgrim-circuit basics done at AC restaurant standard. Useful anchor for groups doing the Buddhist circuit.
insider_tip: Booking through Justdial or direct call works better than walk-in for groups over six. Staff can arrange Jain or no-onion-no-garlic preparations with notice.
signature_address: Tathagat Vihar Hotel, Dangi Tola, Rajgir 803116
